Resolves #4069

The base sort zone's `switchItems` already honors the gap between two swapped slots: it measures the distance between the pair's rects before the swap and places the moved slot after its neighbour plus that same distance, keeping the total span. The tab, grid and table header toolbars inherit this method, so the themed margins between their items survive a reorder. This PR pins that math for the header consumers, including the unequal-size case behind the ticket's 1.5px drift note, and derives the unit tier's DOMRect shim `left`/`top` from `x`/`y` the way the browser does, without which a moved-position write cannot be witnessed in that tier.

Evidence: unit tier (sandbox) → 36 of 36 specs pass locally across `Rectangle.spec.mjs` and `SortZone.spec.mjs`; CI re-runs the tier on this PR.

No structured ACs on #4069.
